fullContentHtml:
RRB Ministerial & Isolated Category CEN 08/2025 Result 2026 – Out – Full Details

Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released the Result for the RRB Ministerial & Isolated Category Posts Post on the official website of RRB. This recruitment was released for 3058 posts. Applications for the RRB Ministerial & Isolated Category Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 30 December 2025, to 29 January 2026. The examination was conducted on 14-15 July 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their RRB Ministerial & Isolated Category Answer Key 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Short Notice Date : 17 December 225
  • Starting Date : 30 December 2025
  • Last Date for Apply : 29 January 2026
  • Last Date Fee Payment : 31 January 2026
  • Form Correction / Modified Date : 01 – 10 February 2026
  • Application Status : 11 May 2026
  • Exam Date : 14-15 July 2026
  • Exam City Details : 04 July 2026
  • Admit Card Available : 10 July 2026
  • Answer Key : 31 July 2026
  • Result : 05 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Fee Refund (After Appearing in Stage I Exam)
  • General, OBC, EWS, : Rs. 400/-

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
